reviews.title: Slow Burn That Keeps You Playing
reviews.text:
The game is all around very enjoyable and the paid currency for in game purchases is fairly common, overall I’d definitely recommend picking it up.

I have some change requests to make the game feel a bit better.

1 - when doing an endless dungeon, save our current progress and let us either do something else for a bit or step away from the game without our dungeon progress being lost.  It feels really bad to essentially have to set aside like an hour to actually run the endless dungeons.

2 - When you purchase an artifact that is part of the Merchants Offer, the price of the offer is not reduced meaning you just get less value and really have no reason to buy it after.
It would really help if you either had the price reduced to reflect the lessened value or just had him move on to his next offer once part of the pack has been purchased with gems.

3 - When fighting the clan boss, once the battle concludes you are not able to fight him again from the end screen and have to navigate through like 3 screens to try again.  Please allow simply trying again from the end screen.

Thank you for your time, if those changes are implemented I’d definitely give it 5 stars.

reviews.title: Decent game
reviews.text: It is an enjoyable game, but it appears to require substantial spending. Equipment costs are prohibitively high, making it difficult to compete against enemies without purchasing in-game coins. Enemies are also challenging when the limited cards offered upon leveling up during a match are ineffective. Finally, the coins awarded do not adequately reflect the effort required to complete a match.

reviews.title: Very well crafted game
reviews.text: This game has many good elements to it. The campaign missions are themed and require some strategy when picking different types of in-mission skills—which are super fun when combining compliment skills! The missions are challenging but not too difficult, and I actually find it fun to replay some missions I’ve previously lost in this game. Upgrading your character and their abilities is streamlined and has variety without being too complex, and there are a good amount of different armors to choose from. The PvP is actually fun. And the best part is you can play offline if you want! This is a really well crafted game. Definitely give it a try and you’ll have some fun with it.

reviews.title: Great till Third Part
reviews.text:
The game is super fun and rewarding until the third part - nightmare . At that point the game becomes impossible. It literally could take 100 tries until you get the rng to beat the level. And there is literally nothing to do about it. Even if one wanted to spend hundreds of dollars on dark steel (the currency use to upgrade) it wouldn’t help. 
What is double frustrating is that if dark steel wasn’t so hard to come by, I imagine one could level up enough to make the levels more doable - Really hard but doable. But after spending an hour on a level to beat it, one is rewarded 5 dark steel which is worthlessj. Even the super fun pirate ship , where one could earn a somewhat decent amount of dark steel, only could be played every two days. I cannot image why the developers are being so stingy with it. It’s not like even paying for it is a viable option unless I’ve spend  1000s of dollars. Great game till act 3. Don’t waste your time if you are going to want to play the full game.

reviews.title: Mostly decent game.
reviews.text:
I actually am mostly enjoying the game, though I believe there are a few issues that could/should (?) be addressed.

First: The fact that the game doesn’t allow iOS users to redeem the redemption codes. According to all of the information I have been able to find the redemption code window should either have a ‘button’ so players can enter a code and redeem it, on the general settings window or some iOS users have to tap the “Credits” button three (3) times to open the redemption code window. Unfortunately for myself running iOS 26.6 neither option works. There is no ‘button’ marked “Redeem” on the general settings window. As for tapping the “Credits” button just opens the Credits window, no it doesn’t matter how many times you tap the Credits button. Three (3) times quickly or twenty (20) times as fast as you can, makes absolutely no difference. All tapping the Credits button does is open the Credits window. 
   Second: The pathetic weapons selection. Seriously? While I do understand the developers aren’t interested in overpowering players but seriously the highest damage raying I have seen after most of the year I have been playing is 10? Seriously? What a load of low level garbage. Now a few do have some slight advantages in magic percentages added to some of the weapons but the damage factor is completely ridiculous at how little damage  can be inflicted per hit. Perhaps there are some higher damage weapons that hasn’t shown up in the game store but I am Level 100, I have all three sets you can purchase with in game gold which aren’t terrible, but the best weapon I have so far discovered in the store, which I check daily, has been 6-10 basic damage value. I have somewhere around 350,000 gold, actually I think it’s closer to 400,000 now. I definitely have plenty of gold to use toward purchasing a weapon that can actually inflict some serious damage.
   I would like to actually be able to actually clear any of the timed runs but unfortunately that is apparently impossible. I repeatedly play the PVP and the Challenges. While I do well in the PVP section I still cannot clear any of the timed challenges even though my defense rating is 244 with 342 as my health. Unfortunately being limited by my damage value being a pathetic 6-17 there is no way to clear ‘literally’, yes really, any of the timed sections. I have cleared both the first and second level of challenges completely, excluding the timed ones, and am working on the third level although I have definitely slowed down my efforts since it doesn’t matter because of the impossibility of clearing the timed levels. For all the excellent cards that can be used none have so far proven to be able to help clear the timed levels. It simply takes longer than we are given because of how long it takes to defeat each opponent. There just isn’t enough time when dealing such minor damage.

reviews.title: Another money grab
reviews.text:
As another reviewer said, this game just wants you to pay for progress.  Failing a mission, which you are supposed to do to grind gold/exp until you can beat it, rewards about 40 gold/experience.  2 hours into the game, your upgrades for 1 out of 8 equipment slots will be 960 gold, and you will need about 1000 exp to level up.  A failed run takes about 3 minutes, so 1 hour minimum per equipment upgrade.  And you WILL fail every new mission you enter.

You can watch a long ad for 150 gold.  Or you can spend $1 and get 1500 gold.  Thats right, people spending $1 on the game will boost them up a full 1 1/2 hours of grinding.  It’s just yet another bare bones, mission based “roguelite” where the dev hopes you get so frustrated you just throw money at the game to feel good.

And surprise, the dev put the pop-up asking you to rate the game within the first 10 minutes, when you are still cruising through the levels buying better equipment after every mission.
